items.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995
items.q: they either play like you or play like Coleman Hawkins.

ctx.x: Well I didn’t think Herschel had a bad night, Herschel Evans. I never thought he had a bad night. Of course Lester declined in his later years from health problems though, with Lester, and I never know what put him on the wrong track because for so many years he was just a health bug. And he was very unhappy with himself the last time we were together we played up to Newport Jazz Festival and he was very sick, he was drinking and drinking. And I rode back with him from Newport and we got lost, which Newport is…
no eagle eyes,” he says, “but I never really made any money.” He didn’t make any money that night.
